question: Which of the following is the longest river in the world? (RPF Constable 2018 (12/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Mekong River
Brahmaputra River
Nile River
Indus River
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Nile River

Explanation:
The Nile River is the longest river in the world, with a length of approximately 6,650 km. It originates from Burundi in East Africa and flows into the Mediterranean Sea. The Nile has two main tributaries: the White Nile and the Blue Nile. It passes through 11 countries including Egypt, Sudan, Ethiopia, Uganda, Tanzania, Kenya, Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Eritrea. The Nile was the backbone of ancient Egyptian civilization and remains the primary water source for Egypt's agriculture and daily life. Although the Amazon River is often considered a contender, the Nile is traditionally recognized as the longest river. It is the most important river in Africa.

Explanation:

question: What is known as Peruvian oceanic currents? (RPF Constable 2018 (12/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Al-Nino
The Benguela Current
Humboldt Current
La Nina
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Humboldt Current

Explanation:
The Peruvian oceanic current is known as the Humboldt Current. It is a cold ocean current that flows along the western coast of South America. Named after the German naturalist Alexander von Humboldt, this current is part of the Humboldt Current System, one of the most productive marine ecosystems in the world. It brings cold water from Antarctica, affecting the coasts of Peru and Chile, causing upwelling which leads to abundant marine life. El Nino is the warming phase of this current, while La Nina is the cooling phase. The Benguela Current is found off the western coast of Africa.

☛ Coast along which Humboldt Current flows → South America

☛ Process caused by Humboldt Current → Upwelling
question_hi: पेरू महासागरीय धाराएं किसे कहते हैं? (RPF Constable 2018 (12/02/2019) Shift 2)

Explanation:
पेरू महासागरीय धारा को हम्बोल्ट धारा भी कहा जाता है। यह एक ठंडी महासागरीय धारा है जो दक्षिण अमेरिका के पश्चिमी तट के साथ बहती है। इसका नाम जर्मन प्रकृतिवादी अलेक्जेंडर वॉन हम्बोल्ट के नाम पर रखा गया है। यह धारा हम्बोल्ट धारा प्रणाली का हिस्सा है, जो दुनिया की सबसे अधिक उत्पादक समुद्री पारिस्थितिकी तंत्रों में से एक है। यह धारा एंटार्कटिका से ठंडा पानी लाकर पेरू और चिली के तटों को प्रभावित करती है, जिससे वहाँ अपवेलिंग (जलोत्थान) होता है और मछलियों की प्रचुरता होती है। अल-नीनो इस धारा के गर्म होने की स्थिति है, जबकि ला नीना इसके ठंडा होने की स्थिति है। बेंगुएला धारा अफ्रीका के पश्चिमी तट पर पाई जाती है।

question: The ocean with the highest depth is _________. (RPF Constable 2018 (14/02/2019))
options: Southern Ocean
Indian Ocean
Arctic Ocean
Pacific Ocean
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Pacific Ocean

Explanation:
The Pacific Ocean is the deepest ocean on Earth. Its maximum depth is approximately 11,034 meters in the Mariana Trench, known as the Challenger Deep. The Pacific Ocean is located between Asia, Australia, the Americas, and Antarctica. It covers an area of about 165.2 million square kilometers, which is about 32% of Earth's surface. The second deepest ocean is the Atlantic Ocean, with a maximum depth of about 8,376 meters in the Puerto Rico Trench. The Indian Ocean has a maximum depth of about 7,725 meters in the Sunda Trench. The Arctic Ocean is the smallest and shallowest, with an average depth of about 1,038 meters. The Pacific Ocean also contains about 25,000 islands of the world.

☛ Deepest point → Challenger Deep (Mariana Trench)
☛ Second deepest ocean → Atlantic Ocean
☛ Smallest ocean → Arctic Ocean
☛ Largest ocean → Pacific Ocean
question_hi: सबसे अधिक गहराई वाला महासागर _________ है। (RPF Constable 2018 (14/02/2019))

solution_hi:

Explanation:
प्रशांत महासागर पृथ्वी पर सबसे गहरा महासागर है। इसकी अधिकतम गहराई मारियाना ट्रेंच में लगभग 11,034 मीटर है, जो चैलेंजर डीप कहलाता है। यह महासागर एशिया, ऑस्ट्रेलिया, अमेरिका और अंटार्कटिका के बीच स्थित है। प्रशांत महासागर का क्षेत्रफल लगभग 165.2 मिलियन वर्ग किमी है, जो पृथ्वी की सतह का लगभग 32% भाग कवर करता है। इसके बाद दूसरा सबसे गहरा महासागर अटलांटिक महासागर है, जिसकी अधिकतम गहराई प्यूर्टो रिको ट्रेंच में लगभग 8,376 मीटर है। हिंद महासागर की अधिकतम गहराई सुंडा ट्रेंच में लगभग 7,725 मीटर है। आर्कटिक महासागर सबसे छोटा और सबसे कम गहरा महासागर है, जिसकी औसत गहराई लगभग 1,038 मीटर है। प्रशांत महासागर में विश्व की लगभग 25,000 द्वीप भी स्थित हैं।

question: In which country is the Rub-al-Khali desert located? (RPF Constable 2018 (16/02/2019))
options: Pakistan
Mongolia
Iran
Saudi Arabia
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Saudi Arabia

Explanation:
The Rub-al-Khali (Empty Quarter) desert is located in southeastern Saudi Arabia. It is the world's largest continuous sand desert, covering an area of approximately 650,000 square kilometers. The desert covers the southeastern part of the Arabian Peninsula and extends into Oman, Yemen, and the United Arab Emirates. Its climate is extremely arid, with annual rainfall less than 35 mm. Temperatures can reach up to 50 degrees Celsius in summer. The region is characterized by vast sand dunes and sand seas.

question: The strait of Florida separates the United States from ________. (RPF Constable 2018 (16/02/2019))
options: Russia
German
Cuba
Mexico
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Cuba

Explanation:
The Strait of Florida is a significant maritime passage that separates the U.S. state of Florida from the island of Cuba. It connects the Atlantic Ocean with the Gulf of Mexico. The strait is approximately 150 kilometers wide and reaches depths of up to 1800 meters. This region is well-known for the Gulf Stream, a warm ocean current that flows through it. The Strait of Florida serves as a natural boundary between the United States and Cuba. Cuba is a major island country located in the Caribbean Sea. This strait is strategically important for trade and military purposes. Additionally, the area is rich in marine biodiversity. The Strait of Florida gets its name from the state of Florida.

Explanation:
फ्लोरिडा जलडमरूमध्य एक महत्वपूर्ण सामुद्रिक मार्ग है जो संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका के फ्लोरिडा राज्य को क्यूबा द्वीप से अलग करता है। यह जलडमरूमध्य अटलांटिक महासागर और मैक्सिको की खाड़ी को जोड़ता है। फ्लोरिडा जलडमरूमध्य लगभग 150 किलोमीटर चौड़ा है और इसकी गहराई 1800 मीटर तक है। यह क्षेत्र गल्फ स्ट्रीम धारा के लिए प्रसिद्ध है, जो एक गर्म समुद्री धारा है। फ्लोरिडा जलडमरूमध्य क्यूबा और अमेरिका के बीच एक प्राकृतिक सीमा का कार्य करता है। क्यूबा कैरेबियन सागर का एक प्रमुख द्वीप देश है। यह जलडमरूमध्य व्यापार और रणनीतिक दृष्टि से महत्वपूर्ण है। इसके अलावा, यह क्षेत्र समुद्री जैव विविधता से समृद्ध है। फ्लोरिडा जलडमरूमध्य का नाम फ्लोरिडा राज्य के नाम पर रखा गया है।

question: Which of the following is found in the Neel River (White Nile)? (RPF Constable 2018 (16/02/2019))
options: Lake Huron
Lake Chad
Lake Tanganyika
Lake Victoria
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Lake Victoria

Explanation:
The White Nile is a major tributary of the Nile River, originating from Lake Victoria. Lake Victoria is Africa's largest lake and the primary water source of the Nile. It is located between Uganda, Kenya, and Tanzania. The White Nile begins its journey from Lake Victoria, flowing through Ripon Falls (now Owen Falls Dam). The Nile is one of the world's longest rivers. The White Nile traverses the swamps of Sudan before merging with the main Nile. Lake Huron is in North America, Lake Chad is in central Africa, and Lake Tanganyika is in the African Great Rift Valley. Among these, only Lake Victoria is the source of the White Nile.

Melanesia

solution:

Explanation:

Oceania includes countries like Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu, and many Pacific island groups. question: The Prime Meridian passes through which of the following continents? (RPF Constable 2018 (16/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Asia
North America
Australia
Africa
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Africa

Explanation:
The Prime Meridian (0° longitude) passes through Greenwich, England and divides the Eastern and Western Hemispheres. It runs through three continents: Europe, Africa, and Antarctica. In Africa, it passes through countries like Ghana, Togo, Burkina Faso, Mali, and Algeria. Asia, North America, and Australia do not touch this line. The Prime Meridian serves as the basis for Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). It was adopted as the international standard in 1884 at the International Meridian Conference.

☛ Which time standard is based on the Prime Meridian? → GMT

question: Where is the Loess Plateau located? (RPF Constable 2018 (16/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: China
Tajikistan
Syria
Iran
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is China

Explanation:
The Loess Plateau is located in China, primarily in the basin of the Yellow River. It is covered with loess soil, which is formed by the accumulation of wind-blown dust. The plateau covers an area of about 640,000 square kilometers and spans the Chinese provinces of Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Gansu.

question: Which of the following is the salinity of ocean / ocean? (RPF Constable 2018 (19/02/2019) Shift 2)
options: Antarctic Ocean
Baltic Sea
Arctic Ocean
Mediterranean Sea
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Mediterranean Sea

Explanation:
The salinity of oceans and seas depends on factors like evaporation, precipitation, river inflow, and ice melting. The Mediterranean Sea has high salinity, around 38-39 PSU, due to high evaporation and limited water exchange with the Atlantic Ocean. It is one of the most saline seas in the world. In contrast, the Baltic Sea has very low salinity (about 7-8 PSU) because of high river inflow and low evaporation. Therefore, the Mediterranean Sea has the highest salinity among the given options.
